annotations.title: Ask Yandex to re-crawl a URL

description: Asks Yandex Webmaster to re-crawl one specific URL on a project's matched host. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION — unlike get_yandex_site_overview, it queues real work on the operator's live Yandex Webmaster account and spends that account's daily recrawl quota. Bring-your-own-token: requires YANDEX_WEBMASTER_OAUTH_TOKEN. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_host' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account. Yandex's own documented failure cases — the URL already queued, or the account's recrawl quota already spent — surface as a normal tool error, not a 200 with ok:false.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: reindex_yandex_url
